title: The Lighthouse
curatorNote: Em uma ilha rochosa isolada no final do seculo XIX, dois faroleiros sucumbem a solidao claustrofobica, segredos sombrios e forcas sobrenaturais insondaveis.
curatorReason: Obra-prima de Robert Eggers com atmosfera hipnotica em preto e branco, mitologia maritima e atuacoes incandescentes sem concessoes comerciais.

omdb.plot: Em uma ilha rochosa isolada no final do seculo XIX, dois faroleiros sucumbem a solidao claustrofobica, segredos sombrios e forcas sobrenaturais insondaveis.

title: Pan's Labyrinth
curatorNote: Na Espanha fascista de 1944, uma jovem descobre um labirinto misterioso guardado por um fauno enigmatico que lhe propoe tarefas fantasticas e aterrorizantes.
curatorReason: Guillermo del Toro equilibra fantasia gotica sombria, monstros de efeitos praticos lendarios e a crueldade terrena em uma das obras mais aclamadas do cinema mundial.

omdb.actors: Ivana Baquero, Ariadna Gil, Sergi López
omdb.plot: In 1944 Francoist Spain, an imaginative young girl meets a faun who tells her she's a princess and that she must prove her worthiness by completing three dangerous tasks.

title: The Sixth Sense
curatorNote: Um psicologo infantil tenta ajudar um menino aterrorizado que alega conseguir ver e se comunicar com os mortos.
curatorReason: Suspense psicologico supremo com roteiro impecavel, atmosfera opressiva dos anos 90 e a mais celebre reviravolta da historia do genero.

omdb.actors: Bruce Willis, Haley Joel Osment, Toni Collette
omdb.plot: After being shot by a resentful former patient whom he failed to help, a Philadelphia child psychologist seeks redemption by treating a young boy with a disturbing secret.

title: The Invisible Man
curatorNote: Apos escapar de um relacionamento abusivo com um cientista bilionario, Cecilia passa a ser perseguida por uma presenca ameacadora que ninguem consegue enxergar.
curatorReason: Leigh Whannell constroi uma aula magistral de paranoia e tensao espacial, com protagonista engenhosa e foco implacavel na sobrevivencia psicológica.

omdb.actors: Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen, Harriet Dyer
omdb.plot: When Cecilia's abusive ex takes his own life and leaves her his fortune, she suspects his death was a hoax. As a series of coincidences turn lethal, Cecilia works to prove that she is being hunted by someone nobody can see.

title: Marrowbone
curatorNote: Quatro irmaos escondem a morte da mae para nao serem separados, mas passam a ser assombrados por uma presenca sinistra confinada no sotao da propriedade.
curatorReason: Producao hispano-americana elegante dirigida por Sergio G. Sanchez, unindo drama de epoca intimista e misterio psicologico denso.

omdb.actors: George MacKay, Anya Taylor-Joy, Charlie Heaton
omdb.plot: A young man and his three younger siblings, who have kept secret the death of their beloved mother in order to remain together, are plagued by a sinister presence in the sprawling manor in which they live.

title: The Babadook
curatorNote: Uma mae viuva exausta descobre que os medos do filho sobre um monstro surgido de um livro infantil sinistro comecam a se manifestar na realidade.
curatorReason: Terror psicologico australiano visceral de Jennifer Kent, aclamado por William Friedkin como um dos filmes mais assustadores ja feitos.

omdb.actors: Essie Davis, Noah Wiseman, Daniel Henshall
omdb.plot: A single mother and her child fall into a deep well of paranoia when an eerie children's book titled "Mister Babadook" manifests in their home.

title: Drag Me to Hell
curatorNote: Uma analista de credito recusa a extensao da hipoteca de uma senhora idosa e acaba sendo alvo de uma maldicao sobrenatural aterradora que ameaca arrasta-la ao inferno.
curatorReason: Sam Raimi retorna ao horror energetico e caricato com efeitos fisicos viscerais, ritmo frenetico e humor negro cortante.

omdb.actors: Alison Lohman, Justin Long, Ruth Livier
omdb.plot: An ambitious loan officer must find a way to shatter a curse that threatens her soul with damnation.

title: Poltergeist II: The Other Side
curatorNote: A familia Freeling se refugia na casa da avo, mas a forca maligna liderada pelo reverendo Kane descobre o paradeiro de Carol Anne.
curatorReason: Classico dos anos 80 marcado pelo design bizarro de criaturas concebidas por H.R. Giger e maquiagem pratica antologica com a dublagem historica da TV.

omdb.actors: JoBeth Williams, Craig T. Nelson, Heather O'Rourke
omdb.plot: The Freeling family have a new house, but their troubles with supernatural forces don't seem to be over.

title: Insidious
curatorNote: Apos um garoto entrar em coma inexplicavel, os pais descobrem que seu espirito esta preso em uma dimensao astral sombria habitada por entidades que desejam possuir seu corpo.
curatorReason: James Wan e Leigh Whannell reinventam o horror de casa mal-assombrada com trilha estridente no piano e cenografia teatral aterrorizante.

omdb.actors: Patrick Wilson, Rose Byrne, Ty Simpkins
omdb.plot: A family looks to prevent evil spirits from trapping their comatose child in a realm called The Further.

title: Midsommar
ptTitle: Midsommar: O Mal Nao Espera a Noite
curatorNote: Um casal americano viaja a um festival de verao isolado na Suecia rural que rapidamente se transforma em um pesadelo pagan sob a luz implacavel do solsticio.
curatorReason: Ari Aster constroi um terror folk perturbador e claustrofobico a ceu aberto, explorando catarse emocional e rituais arcaicos sem os cliches da escuridao.

omdb.actors: Florence Pugh, Jack Reynor, Vilhelm Blomgren
omdb.plot: A couple travels to Northern Europe to visit a rural hometown's fabled Swedish mid-summer festival. What begins as an idyllic retreat quickly devolves into an increasingly violent and bizarre competition at the hands of a pagan cult.

streamName: Midsommar: O Mal Não Espera a Noite [L]

title: The Wicker Man
curatorNote: Clássico definitivo do horror pagão folclórico dirigido por Robin Hardy com Christopher Lee. Um policial cristão devoto viaja a uma remota ilha escocesa para investigar o sumiço de uma jovem e depara-se com rituais celtas antigos.
curatorReason: Tensão psicológica em crescendo luminoso sob a luz do dia, culminando em uma oferenda ritualística inesquecível sobre crença e isolamento.

omdb.title: The Wicker Man
omdb.actors: Edward Woodward, Christopher Lee, Diane Cilento
omdb.plot: On Sunday, April 29, 1973, Sergeant Neil Howie with the West Highland Constabulary flies solo to Summerisle off the coast of Scotland. He is there to follow up on a letter addressed specifically to him from an anonymous source on Summerisle reporting that a twelve year old girl who lives on the island, Rowan Morrison, the daughter of May Morrison, has long been missing. The correspondence includes a photograph of Rowan. Upon his arrival on Summerisle, Howie finds that the locals are a seemingly simple minded lot who provide little information beyond the fact that they know of no Rowan Morrison and do not know the girl in the photo. Mrs. Morrison admits to having a daughter, seven year old Myrtle, but no Rowan. As Howie speaks to more and more people, he begins to believe that Rowan does or did live on the island, but that the locals are hiding their knowledge of her. He also begins to see that the locals all have pagan beliefs, their "religion" which centers on procreation as the source of life. That procreation does not necessarily need to be within marriage, and openly flaunts the act of sex, both in private and in public. These beliefs do not sit well against Howie's strict Christian morals, he who regularly attends church, prays, and accepts communion. Everything that happens on the island seems to be dictated by Lord Summerisle, whose ancestors bought the island generations ago. Howie begins to believe that Rowan was murdered, she a sacrifice by the islanders to their higher power to ensure a bountiful apple crop - the main crop of the island - which did not materialize last season. With May Day approaching, Howie not only tries to find out if Rowan was indeed murdered/sacrificed, which includes trying to locate her body, but if there will be another sacrifice on this important day within the cycle of life.

title: Hereditary
curatorNote: Aclamada obra de Ari Aster estrelada por Toni Collette. Após a morte da avó reclusa, uma família começa a desvendar segredos crípticos e cada vez mais aterrorizantes sobre sua linhagem ancestral.
curatorReason: Um horror visceral e psicológico dilacerante sobre trauma geracional, dor do luto e forças ocultas manipulando marionetes humanas predestinadas.

omdb.title: Hereditary
omdb.actors: Toni Collette, Milly Shapiro, Gabriel Byrne
omdb.plot: When Ellen, the matriarch of the Graham family, passes away, her daughter's family begins to unravel cryptic and increasingly terrifying secrets about their ancestry. The more they discover, the more they find themselves trying to outrun the sinister fate they seem to have inherited. Making his feature debut, writer-director Ari Aster unleashes a nightmare vision of a domestic breakdown that exhibits the craft and precision of a nascent auteur, transforming a familial tragedy into something ominous and deeply disquieting, and pushing the horror movie into chilling new terrain with its shattering portrait of heritage gone to hell.

title: Event Horizon
curatorNote: Ficção científica cult de horror cósmico com Laurence Fishburne e Sam Neill. Uma nave de resgate é enviada para investigar uma nave de pesquisa que reapareceu anos após entrar em um buraco negro dimensional.
curatorReason: Uma descida aos abismos do inferno espacial Lovecraftiano onde as leis da física se dobram à loucura absoluta da carne e do vazio.

omdb.title: Donnie Brasco
omdb.writer: Joseph D. Pistone, Richard Woodley, Paul Attanasio
omdb.actors: Al Pacino, Johnny Depp, Michael Madsen
omdb.plot: This true story follows FBI agent Joe Pistone as he infiltrates the New York Mafia. Befriending Lefty Ruggiero, Pistone (under the name Donnie Brasco) is able to embed himself in a Mafia faction led by Sonny Black. Ruggiero and Pistone become tight as the group goes about collecting money for "the bosses." Eventually, the group become big-time when Black himself becomes a boss; all the while, Pistone collects evidence. However, the trials and tribulations of the undercover work become more than Pistone can bear. His marriage falls apart, and to top it off, the Mafia suspect a mole in the organization. The real dilemma is afforded to Pistone, who knows that if he walks away from the Mafia, Ruggiero will be the one punished.
omdb.awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 2 wins & 16 nominations total

title: Color Out of Space
ptTitle: A Cor Que Caiu do Espaço
curatorNote: Adaptação estilizada do conto clássico de H.P. Lovecraft por Richard Stanley com Nicolas Cage. Um meteorito alienígena brilha com uma cor impossível no quintal de uma família no campo, infectando terra, animais e mentes.
curatorReason: Psicodelia visual magenta aterradora, delírio cósmico e a insidiosa contaminação do organismo humano pelo desconhecido.

omdb.title: Color Out of Space
omdb.writer: H.P. Lovecraft, Richard Stanley, Scarlett Amaris
omdb.actors: Nicolas Cage, Joely Richardson, Madeleine Arthur
omdb.plot: The Gardner family relocates to a New England farmstead already under strain, Theresa recovering from cancer surgery, Lavinia chafing against rural isolation. When a meteorite strikes their property and saturates the land with an unclassifiable color, the contamination moves inward, through soil, water, livestock, and finally flesh. Ward, a young hydrologist surveying the region, watches from the margins as the family fractures under pressure no diagnosis can contain. The farm becomes a closed system. Nothing that enters it leaves unchanged.

streamName: A Cor Que Caiu do Espaço

title: Annihilation
curatorNote: Ficção científica e horror cósmico deslumbrante de Alex Garland com Natalie Portman e Jennifer Jason Leigh. Uma equipe de mulheres cientistas adentra o 'Brilho', uma zona costeira misteriosa onde a genética está em mutação constante.
curatorReason: Uma metáfora visual e sonora impressionante sobre autodestruição celular, beleza alienígena incompreensível e a dissolução da identidade orgânica.

omdb.title: Annihilation
omdb.actors: Natalie Portman, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Tessa Thompson
omdb.plot: A biologist's husband disappears. She puts her name forward for an expedition into an environmental disaster zone, but does not find what she's expecting. The expedition team is made up of the biologist, an anthropologist, a psychologist, a surveyor, and a linguist.
